entries.title: Colossians 4:1
segments: Masters, render unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

entries.title: Colossians 4:2
segments: Continue stedfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

entries.title: Colossians 4:3
segments: withal praying for us also, that God may open unto us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;

entries.title: Colossians 4:4
segments: that I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

entries.title: Colossians 4:5
segments: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

entries.title: Colossians 4:6
segments: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer each one.

entries.title: Colossians 4:7
segments: All my affairs shall Tychicus make known unto you, the beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow-servant in the Lord:

entries.title: Colossians 4:8
segments: whom I have sent you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts;

entries.title: Colossians 4:9
segments: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things that [are done] here.

entries.title: Colossians 4:10
segments: Aristarchus my fellow-prisoner saluteth you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (touching whom ye received commandments; if he come unto you, receive him),

entries.title: Colossians 4:11
segments: and Jesus that is called Justus, who are of the circumcision: these only [are my] fellow-workers unto the kingdom of God, men that have been a comfort unto me.

entries.title: Colossians 4:12
segments: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, saluteth you, always striving for you in his prayers, that ye may stand perfect and fully assured in all the will of God.

entries.title: Colossians 4:13
segments: For I bear him witness, that he hath much labor for you, and for them in Laodicea, and for them in Hierapolis.

entries.title: Colossians 4:14
segments: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas salute you.

entries.title: Colossians 4:15
segments: Salute the brethren that are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church that is in their house.

entries.title: Colossians 4:16
segments: And when this epistle hath been read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye also read the epistle from Laodicea.

entries.title: Colossians 4:17
segments: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

entries.title: Colossians 4:18
segments: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you.
